verdict.rationale: TaxJar's evidence pack shows a US-focused sales-tax API (rate calculation, nexus tracking, AutoFile) plus a bare VAT-number validation endpoint (taxjar-gh-5), but nothing about generating or flowing through compliant invoice fields, registration numbers, or locale-specific invoice rules for VAT jurisdictions. TaxJar is explicitly positioned as built for US-only sellers (taxjar-docs-18, taxjar-docs-24), with no documentation of VAT-compliant invoice generation or field mapping.
